_comment: Per-unit overrides on top of data/bsdata/parsed.json. Each entry can partially override any field (health, damage, hit_probability, ap, save, name, enabled, notes). Standalone entries listed here that don't exist in parsed.json become fully hand-rolled units; they must specify all required fields.

necrons_necron_warriors.notes: 10e Necron Warriors carry the Their Number Is Legion rule — they have OC equal to a normal infantryman PLUS hold objectives even after leaving them. Sourced from wahapedia.ru Necrons datasheet.

genestealer_cults_acolyte_hybrids_with_h.notes: 10e GSC Acolyte Hybrids have Cult Ambush which keeps objective control after the unit leaves. Sourced from wahapedia.ru Genestealer Cults datasheet.

genestealer_cults_acolyte_hybrids_with_a.notes: 10e GSC Acolyte Hybrids have Cult Ambush which keeps objective control after the unit leaves. Sourced from wahapedia.ru Genestealer Cults datasheet.

death_guard_plague_marines.notes: Death Guard army rule Disgustingly Resilient grants every DEATH GUARD model FNP 5+. The rule is codex-level and is not encoded on individual BSData datasheets, so the mapper cannot see it — override here. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/death-guard/ (Army Rule: Disgustingly Resilient).

chaos_space_marines_plague_marines.notes: Cross-codex BSData entry for Plague Marines; canonical datasheet lives in the Death Guard codex and carries Disgustingly Resilient (FNP 5+). Pricing and stats are identical to death_guard_plague_marines. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/death-guard/#Plague-Marines.

aeldari_aeldari_library_wraithguard.notes: Wraithguard have a 4+ invulnerable save listed on their datasheet, but BSData does not encode it (no Invulnerable-Save infoLink in the unit entry). Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/aeldari/#Wraithguard. | sweg_balance_mc up 198.8 -> 218.68 pts/model

aeldari_aeldari_library_wraithblades.notes: Wraithblades have a 4+ invulnerable save listed on their datasheet, but BSData does not encode it. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/aeldari/#Wraithblades.

space_marines_intercessor_squad.notes: Standard Primaris Marine 32mm round. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/space-marines/#Intercessor-Squad (Base size).

adeptus_custodes_custodian_guard.notes: Custodian Guard ship on 40mm rounds. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/#Custodian-Guard (Base size).

space_marines_repulsor_executioner.notes: Repulsor / Repulsor Executioner hover-tank footprint approximated as 102x178mm (no GW-supplied base — kit sits on its grav-plates). Reference: GW dimensions for the Repulsor kit (~7"x4").

t_au_empire_riptide_battlesuit.notes: Riptide ships on an 80mm round. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/tau-empire/#Riptide-Battlesuit (Base size). | sweg_balance_mc up 1192.5 -> 1311.75 pts/model

tyranids_hive_tyrant.notes: Foot Hive Tyrant ships on an 80mm round. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/tyranids/#Hive-Tyrant (Base size).

tyranids_winged_hive_tyrant.notes: Winged Hive Tyrant ships on a 170x105mm oval flying base. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/tyranids/#Winged-Hive-Tyrant (Base size).

space_marines_terminator_squad.notes: Terminators ship on 40mm rounds. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/space-marines/#Terminator-Squad (Base size).
